note: San Bernardino NF campground off Hwy 38 in the upper Santa Ana River headwaters at about 6,900 ft, near the San Gorgonio Wilderness; three loops (Sugarloaf, Aspen, Grinnell Peak) under mature pines with little understory, so some sites lack privacy. Bear box at every site. A dump station with water is nearby. Run by a concessionaire. --Claude
